hint:
A request value joined into a shell command string reaches os.system().
Only an argument list with no shell stops this class.

vulnerable.code:
import os
from flask import Flask, request
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/ping")
def ping():
    host = request.args["host"]
    os.system("ping -c 1 " + host)
    return "ok"

safe.code:
import subprocess
from flask import Flask, request
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/ping")
def ping():
    host = request.args["host"]
    args = ["ping", "-c", "1", "--", host]
    subprocess.run(args, check=False)
    return "ok"
